top_signals.title: Congo Ebola Outbreak Spreads Beyond Ituri as Cases Rise in North Kivu
top_signals.summary: Ebola is spreading rapidly beyond the main epicenter of Democratic Republic of Congo’s outbreak, overwhelming treatment capacity in some areas and putting mounting pressure on efforts to trace and contain infections.

top_signals.title: Australian Unemployment Rises, Traders Pare Rate-Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: Australia’s unemployment rate unexpectedly rose in July, supporting the Reserve Bank’s view that the labor market is likely to gradually loosen and prompting traders to pare bets on another interest-rate increase.

top_signals.title: Fish, ships and sovereignty: Iceland weighs its European future
top_signals.summary: For many Icelanders, the vote boils down to a trade-off: if lower interest rates and a seat at Europe's table are worth ceding some control over fisheries and self-determination.
